title: Tasweere Mohammed Hai Laila Ki Kamayi Hai
body:
Zalimo Zara Socho Jo Tum Ne Mitayi Hai
Tasweere Mohammed Hai Laila Ki Kamayi Hai
Shabbir Bhala Dekhe Kistarha Se ye Manzar
Akbar Ke Kaleje Me Barchi Jo Darayi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Ne Kaha Baba Jald Aao Madad Karne
Hai Laash Jawan Ran Me Tanha Mera Bhai Hai
Peeri Ka Sahara Tha Jo Sibte Payamber Ki
Barchi Ushi Meh-Ru Ko Aada Ne Lagayi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kahte The Shahe Wala Aada Se Ye Ro-Ro Ke
Nana Ki Mere Tum Ne Tasweer Mitayi Hai
Zainab Ka Dil Wo Jaan Hai Athara Baras Ka
Tashna-Labi Pa Uski Har Aankh Bhar-Ayi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Ne Kaha Bhaiya Qaime Se Mai Aati Hu
Ab Teri Madad Mai Karne Bete Hai Na Bhai Hai
Ta-Umr Kabhi Laila Saaye Me Na Baithegi
Zalim Ne Kaleje Me Wo Aag Lagayi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Peeri Me Uthayi Hai Jo Laash-e-Jawan Mazhar
Shabbir Ki Himmat Par Hairan Khudayi Hai
